rejected_rule.statement: A borrower who retains possession of a property after a loan transaction may be deemed to have reserved the beneficial interest in the property, even if the deed appears to be an outright transfer.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: if the relevant attendant circumstances were sufficient to demonstrate that the Plaintiff hardly intended to dispose of his beneficial interest then it would be logical to elucidate that the beneficial interest of the property was not parted with by the Plaintiff.
